label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
To my neighbours on Aughrim Terrace,

I’m putting this through every door because I don’t know who’s doing it, and I’d rather say it straight than keep stewing about it. Someone on this terrace has been filling my grey bin with their rubbish. Not a few bits now and then — full black bags, every week, for about a month. I’m fuming, to be honest.

I rent at no. 14. The bin has 14 painted on the lid in white. It’s a Greenmount Bins grey bin and I’m charged by weight — 0.41 a kilo. My last bill was €63.20 for two months. It’s usually around €25. So I’m not just annoyed, I’m paying for someone else’s crap. The bin goes out Tuesday night for Wednesday collection.

Last Tuesday I got home at 3am after a gig and the lid wouldn’t close. There were three black bags in it that weren’t mine. One had nappies in it. In another I found a gas bill envelope with the name torn off — only Aughrim Terrace left on it. A fella across the road saw a car pull up on Tuesday evening but didn’t see who it was.

I work nights. I’m not a pushover, and I’m not going to keep paying for this. I’ve no interest in a row with the whole terrace over one person’s carry-on, so I’m not throwing accusations around. But whoever it is needs to stop. Simple as that.

If you’re stuck and need to know where to bring your rubbish, ask me and I’ll tell you who to ring. It’s not hard. If it keeps going, I’ll be putting a padlock on the bin.

I’d rather this was the end of it.

No. 14
